review:
Zeus vs Hades POP is a Pragmatic Play slot that shrinks the gods of the original Zeus vs Hades game onto a 5x3 grid with a simpler feature set. Expanding wilds can land on any reel; when one is part of a win it fills the whole reel and carries a random multiplier of up to 100x. Three scatters trigger five free spins, and every expanding wild that lands during the feature stays on the grid until it ends.

The POP part is the instant jackpot: one, two or three POP symbols in a feature-triggering combination pay the 50x Snap, 500x Spark or 25,000x Burst jackpot before the free spins start, and three POP symbols together pay the 25,000x maximum win outright. Play the free demo to see how quickly the sticky wilds fill the reels in a five-spin feature. It suits players who want a short, sharp bonus rather than a long free spins round.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
